suspend.title: Suspend Reader
suspend.description: This will suspend the reader's account and prevent access to the platform.

unsuspend.title: Unsuspend Reader
unsuspend.description: This will restore the reader's access to the platform.

wallet.title: Adjust Wallet Balance
wallet.description: Add or deduct funds from this reader's wallet.

flag.description: Flag this reader's account for attention.

unflag.title: Remove Flag

notFound.title: Reader Not Found
notFound.description: The reader you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.

userManagement.title: User Account Management
userManagement.description: These actions affect the user account directly, not just the reader profile.

banDialog.title: Ban User (Permanent)
banDialog.description: This will permanently ban the user from the platform. They will not be able to log in or access any features.
banDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Enter reason for banning this user

unbanDialog.title: Unban User
unbanDialog.description: This will remove the permanent ban and allow the user to access the platform again.
unbanDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Enter reason for unbanning this user

resetPasswordDialog.title: Reset User Password
resetPasswordDialog.description: This will send a password reset email to the user. They will need to click the link to set a new password.

verifyEmailDialog.verifyDescription: This will manually mark the email as verified without requiring the user to click a verification link.
verifyEmailDialog.unverifyDescription: This will mark the email as unverified.

sendEmailDialog.title: Send Email to User
sendEmailDialog.description: Send a custom email to this user. The email will be sent from the platform.
